decisions.reason: Rejected for visible exposure mismatch after exact-source/raw-master comparison: the original face and hair form an almost black silhouette with only very faint facial and clothing edges, whereas the current master clearly reveals a broad yellow lower face, conspicuous green eye rings, illuminated swept hair and a bright left facial rim. Restore the original near-black subject exposure and faint source-visible edges without introducing stronger face, eye, hair or shirt illumination. This decision does not ask to alter unrelated features: the yellow mascot identity, dark swept hairstyle, suit/closed shirt collar/tie, short broad head-to-collar contact, tilted full photograph frame and overlapping note remain recognizable; the note retains two compact mark rows with the remaining paper blank. Full white/cyan and alpha views show retained opaque photographic backing and no obvious interior transparency hole; source and returned alpha extrema are both 0/255, so this is not a claim that every interior pixel was numerically proven alpha255, nor a rejection based on isolated exterior RGB specks.
